entities.summary: Jean-Michel Antoine Aulas is a French businessman and politician. He is the founder of Cegid, and from 1987 to 2023, he served as the president of French football club Lyon, which he had owned from 1987 to 2022 before selling a majority stake to John Textor. As part of OL Groupe, Aulas also previously owned and was the chairman of American club OL Reign from 2020 to 2022.
